column1: # Campaign manifest for h200_campaign_queue.sh: what remains of EXP-R2-207 after R1 landed and R4 was cancelled.
# Columns, tab-separated: slot <TAB> key <TAB> gpu <TAB> stage <TAB> label <TAB> env <TAB> args
# `--device` and `--out` are injected by the runner and must never appear in args.
# ${TRANSFER_MODEL_BASE_DIR} is substituted in-pod after h200_env.sh is sourced, so the model root stays declared once.
# ONE SNAPSHOT. Every cell here is 17_train_transcoder.py at pinned commit bd6ff99 -- the trainer EXP-R2-191 and
# EXP-R2-204 ran, byte-identical to 04fdfa5, the code state that trained every baseline these cells are read against.
# The Crosscoder cells that needed a second snapshot are gone from this campaign: EXP-R2-206 completed and was read,
# and EXP-R2-208's pair is running under the driver. The runner's own copy comes from whichever snapshot launches it
# and is independent of the cells' code provenance, so a `cc` key is not needed here.
# WHY THIS FILE REPLACES campaign_r206_r207.tsv rather than editing it. That manifest's labels are not the labels the
# cells were dispatched under -- it says `r207_r1_d8192_base_protein_s20260815` where the run is
# `r207_r1_base_s20260815` -- and the resume rule keys on the output directory, which is the label. Dispatching it
# today would re-run four completed R1 cells rather than skip them. Every label below is the label its cell will
# actually carry, and none of them exists on GPFS yet.
# WHAT IS NOT HERE. R4 (d_hidden 16,384 replicates) is cancelled: `R` is resolved, and pricing the f16 numerators
# cannot change a conclusion already 23 sd from the null on the weaker checkpoint. The Crosscoder re-run is not here
# because its lambda is not settled until EXP-R2-208's pair is read at the endpoint; slot 2 leaves two cards free and
# is where it goes once it is.
# SLOTS are execution barriers, not the pre-registered rounds. R2's second pair leads slot 1 because the coordinator's
# priority order puts completing the text `f8` denominator above the curvature point. Slot 1's barrier is set by the
# text cells at ~4.9 h; the two protein R3 cells beside them run ~3.7 h. Slot 2 is the two text R3 cells at ~3.2-3.4 h.
# VOID CONDITIONS carried from EXP-R2-207, unchanged. Protein must realise 36,978 steps / 147,912 sequences /
# 34,001,183 scored tokens with the screen keeping 961 of 1,024 at max containment 1.0000 over 229,376 records; text
# must realise 11,367 / 45,468 / 34,002,081 with 1,024 of 1,024 at 0.4346 over 106,496. `--steps` is the DECLARED
# value, 56,000 protein and 26,000 text, because it sets the held-out offset. The three optimiser flags are omitted
# exactly as the r24_plt_* baselines omitted them, so each cell is argument-identical to its baseline except for the
# one axis it varies: `--seed` for R2, `--d-hidden` for R3.
